spec.concept: A Sentinel Grove review report that lists each finding with its severity, root cause and recommended fix, shown as a clean structured report card.
spec.scene: Flat brand card on a deep navy background. A simplified report sheet sits at center-right with three stacked rows, each with a small amber marker beside a short line, suggesting severity, root cause and fix. A thin amber rule runs beneath the overlay text on the left. No people, no code, no badges, no logos beyond a minimal grove-inspired mark.
spec.overlay_text: each finding with its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix
spec.alt_text: Navy card with a simplified report sheet showing three rows, each with an amber marker, beside the text: each finding with its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix.

spec.concept: Credibility through a simple, factual track record for a smart contract audit firm
spec.scene: Clean brand card with a deep navy background, a single amber accent line beneath the main text, and a subtle minimal grove-of-trees motif in white outline along the bottom edge. Calm, uncluttered, engineering feel.
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with white text reading 12 smart contract audits and an amber accent line beneath it.

spec.concept: ERC-4626 vault inflation attack: a donation inflates the share price so a victim's deposit rounds down to zero shares
spec.scene: Technical diagram on a deep navy background. On the left, a vault box holding a single share token. An amber arrow labeled as a direct transfer enters the vault from the side, bypassing the deposit door. On the right, a victim's deposit of 100 tokens approaches the vault and turns into an empty share slot showing zero. Clean thin line art, monospace labels, ample spacing, calm engineering feel.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a vault holding one share while a direct token transfer inflates its balance and a victim's deposit converts to zero shares.

spec.concept: Reentrancy: external calls can reenter before state is finalized
spec.scene: Technical diagram on a deep navy background: two contract boxes labeled A and B, with an arrow from A calling B and a return arrow looping back into A before A's balance field is cleared. The balance field is highlighted in amber to mark the unchanged state. Clean line work, ample empty space for the overlay text.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of two contracts where contract A calls contract B and B calls back into A before A's balance is cleared, illustrating reentrancy.

spec.concept: Education card on unprotected Ether withdrawal: missing caller checks let any account move Ether out of a contract.
spec.scene: Dark navy background with a simple padlock outline in amber standing open beside a stylized contract block, with a thin amber line showing Ether leaving the block. Clean, calm, minimal engineering style with generous empty space for the overlay text.
spec.alt_text: Navy card with an open amber padlock beside a contract block and a line showing Ether leaving it, with the text: Limit withdrawals to authorized parties.

spec.concept: Weak randomness on Ethereum: public or influenceable block values used as secret entropy
spec.scene: Technical card on a deep navy background. A simple diagram shows three block fields (timestamp, blockhash, difficulty) as open boxes feeding into a winner-selection function, with an amber warning marker on the arrows. Clean line work, monospace labels, ample spacing.
spec.overlay_text: Creating a strong source of randomness on Ethereum is challenging.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of block.timestamp, blockhash and block.difficulty feeding into a winner-selection function, with an amber warning marker showing these values are influenceable.
